svg.text: Zoom 2 · one K/V unit: a row per full-attention layer
Unit 22 = A's page 3, tokens 96–127 (96–99 written so far). 16 rows, one per full-attention layer, in memory order: row g starts at byte g × 128 KiB
16 rows × 128 KiB = 2 MiB. Each row: K and V for the 4 KV heads of that layer.
Layers 0–2, 4–6, … 60–62 are linear attention: they have no row here (zoom 5).
